plain: A leader who gains power by stirring up emotion and prejudice

webster.text: A leader of the people; an orator who pleases the populace and influences them to adhere to him.

example.quote: There will be scarcely a chance of their uniting in any other but some great man, unless in some popular demagogue, who will probably be destitute of principle.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 2, New York Convention, June 21, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
